review_time_definition: Wall-clock from first detailed inspection to submission; includes coordination/tool delays, not independent human labor.

anchors.quote: Conditionally formulate each pivot selection as search over indices i in [col,n) using the ordered key (abs(rows[i][col]), -i), so the result must be the largest absolute pivot and the lowest index among ties. A Grover-style maximum-finding construction would require repeated reversible predicates comparing an indexed key with an incumbent or threshold. This is only a structural formulation; its probabilistic behavior does not satisfy the software contract without an exactness and failure policy.

Encode the active index range, col, and the current augmented-row pivot-column values. Supply reversible indexed access to rows[i][col] and implement binary64 absolute-value, comparison, equality, and index tie-breaking. Account for data loading, coherent storage or recomputation, ancillas, and uncomputation; none is assumed free.

Measure a candidate pivot index, check classically that it is in range, and verify against every active row that no larger absolute pivot or earlier equal pivot exists. Only a verified exact index may enter the existing zero-pivot check and row swap. Any failed or inconclusive quantum attempt must use a defined retry or classical fallback policy preserving deterministic behavior.

binding.rationale: Primary plan specifies the desired ordered key (magnitude,-index) but only sketches adaptive predicates against an incumbent or threshold. It does not supply a complete selection procedure or marking relation on reachable binary64 states. Output decoding describes a classical certificate, not the construction of the primary search; do not convert it into a favorable primary selector. More precise location is separate from these unresolved obligations.
